description: This Java class, CampaignsHelper, provides utility methods for managing SMS campaign resources via REST API calls within integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to create, verify, update, delete, and perform actions on campaigns, as well as fetch report options needed for campaign configuration.

classes.name: CampaignsHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing SMS campaigns in integration testing, encapsulating REST API interactions for campaign CRUD operations and report retrieval.

methods.name: createCampaign
methods.description: Creates a new SMS campaign via REST API call, returning the campaign ID.

methods.name: verifyCampaignCreatedOnServer
methods.description: Checks if a campaign with the given ID exists on the server.

methods.name: updateCampaign
methods.description: Updates an existing campaign identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteCampaign
methods.description: Deletes a campaign by its ID.

methods.name: performActionsOnCampaign
methods.description: Performs a specified command action on a campaign, such as activating or closing.

methods.name: performActionsOnCampaignWithFailure
methods.description: Performs an action on a campaign expecting failure scenarios.

methods.name: getCreateCampaignJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for creating a campaign with parameters reportName and triggerType.

methods.name: getUpdateCampaignJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for updating a campaign.

methods.name: getJSONForCampaignAction
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for performing an action (like close or activate) on a campaign.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Fetches available report options used for campaign configuration.

methods.name: getSelectedReportId
methods.description: Retrieves the report ID matching the provided report name.
